title: Module Review Quiz: File I/O Stream Manipulation (CPP_265 to CPP_272)

slides.title: File I/O Stream Manipulation Overview
slides.prompt: This Module Quiz covers file stream classes (std::ifstream, std::ofstream, std::fstream), open modes, binary file I/O, stream manipulators (std::setw, std::setprecision), error states, and std::stringstream (CPP_265 to CPP_272).

slides.title: File I/O Header (CPP_265)
slides.prompt: Fill in the header file name required to work with file input and output streams in C++.

slides.title: Writing to Files (CPP_265)
slides.prompt: Which C++ class is specifically used for creating and writing data to files?

slides.title: Reading from Files (CPP_266)
slides.prompt: Fill in the stream class used for reading data from an existing file.

slides.title: File Open Modes (CPP_267)
slides.prompt: Which open mode flag is used to append new output data to the end of an existing file instead of overwriting it?

slides.title: Checking File Open Status (CPP_267)
slides.prompt: Fill in the boolean member function name used to verify if a file stream was successfully opened.

slides.title: Binary File Flag (CPP_268)
slides.prompt: Which flag must be combined in the open mode when performing unformatted raw binary file reading/writing?

slides.title: Writing Raw Bytes (CPP_268)
slides.prompt: Fill in the method name used to write binary block data to a file stream.

slides.title: Stream Manipulators Header (CPP_269)
slides.prompt: Which header file is required to use manipulators like std::setw, std::setprecision, and std::setfill?

slides.title: Formatting Field Width (CPP_269)
slides.prompt: Fill in the manipulator name used to set the field width for the next output item.

slides.title: Floating-Point Precision (CPP_269)
slides.prompt: What does 'cout << fixed << setprecision(2) << 3.14159;' print to standard output?

slides.title: String Streams (CPP_270)
slides.prompt: Fill in the header file required to convert between strings and other data types using stringstream.

slides.title: Stream Position Seeking (CPP_271)
slides.prompt: Which function is used to change the read position pointer (get pointer) inside an input file stream?

slides.title: Detecting End-Of-File (CPP_272)
slides.prompt: Which stream method returns true when a read operation attempts to read beyond the end of a file?
